newsitem.title: USA: ComEd 794 MW nuke seen up early next week.
newsitem.headline: ComEd 794 MW nuke seen up early next week.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden nuclear power unit 3 was expected to return to service early in the week of January 22 following a maintenance shutdown, a spokesman said Tuesday.
"It's looking to us like it will be more early next week" for a startup of the unit, spokesman Gary Wald said.
The unit, located in Morris, Ill., was shut October 26, 1996 for maintenance. It is tentatively scheduled to again be shut for maintenance and refueling in March.
"We are awaiting approval from the NRC (Nuclear Regulatory Commission) on some changes to (Dresden 3's) technical specifications," Wald said.
The adjacent Dresden nuclear power unit 2, also with a capacity of 794 MW, was operating at 100 percent of capacity.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
